productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I got these during the Great Amazon Sale for around 4.5k and I believe it to be worth every penny.This is my second pair of TWS and I am not an experienced tws reviewer or anything. Just the experience of a common user. Below are my detailed thoughts about this TWS.Build 4/5 - Very good build. Sturdy and solid design. The matte finish helps keep any dirt and fingerprint away from the case. Although the buds are not free from fingerprints and dirt.Keep in mind that they are oval shaped and the casing is oval as well. So round eartips might not fit the casing.Comfort 2/5 - Totally subjective. My ears aren't made for oval shaped earbuds. The buds press hard around the crus helix (look it up) and it gets sore if I wear the earbuds constantly for more than 20-30 mins. After a couple of week, the pain is less. I have tried different size eartips to no avail. I am looking for covers for buds that might help.ANC - 4.5/5 - Dont have any issue with this. Enough and perfect for my use case. I use it indoors mostly. Never had any problem with external noise.Features 5/5 - I have a OnePlus phone so I don't even need a third party app like HeyMelody. The functions are baked into the Bluetooth earbud settings. All the necessary settings can be set through Bluetooth settings. For other phones, HeyMelody app offers all the necessary functions.Gestures work almost flawlessly. At time too flawlessly as even mistouches get registered.  Google assistant works great.Battery 5/5 - Just charged once in 10 days. Although I am not an avid user due to the comfort user. But usually will last you long enough without any worries even for heavy users.Call quality 4/5 - Havent had any issues. Havent tested thoroughly though. Might update later.Sound Quality - 9/10 (for the price)The rating has a few caveats. So far I have learnt that having compatible devices make a lot of difference. If you have a device of the same company in this case OnePlus your experience will be much better. These buds sounds better with my phone than with my Ipad while its never the case for other earphones.Coming to the quality of the soundBass - 10/10. If you're a basshead, close your eyes and get these. This is where it shines. Everything is catering to the bass.Mids 7.5/10 - Subdued by the bass. With equalizer you can make it better. Although I didnt have any issue hearing vocals, some instruments can be subdued by the bass. Drums dont sound authentic. For rock and metal songs the instruments sound mushy.Highs 8/10 - Not too bright. Sounds Pleasant. Unlike many earbuds it doesn't have the hiss in the higher frequencies.Clarity - 9/10 - This honestly surprised me. Never expected a TWS in this range to sound this clear.Sound Stage 7.5/10 - Not bad at all. Not as wide as some IEMs at this range but inderstable. Surround sound can improve the staging. But decreases the quality and clarity.Volume -5/5 This is a huge issue with many TWS. They are way too timid. This might depend on the compatible devices though. In my phone its really loud even with 50% volume. My last pair Oppo Enco air 2 were really timid even in full volume.I own 2 more IEMsKZ Zsn Pro (2k) and Simgot EW200 (4k)In terms of bass it is better than both. And I prefer this over the KZ in every category. Thats saying something for a TWS that it is beating out budget IEMs. I have heard it can compete with the like of 7z and Moondrop Chu.Although the Simgot is way ahead in terms of clarity, mids and sound Stage which is understandable. But I prefer the OP buds 3 for pop and hip hop because of that amazing bass.Too long a review. Hope this helps in your decision to purchase these.Buy if -Have OnePlus device.Bass lover/ Pop, hip hop, edm, bollywood listener.Needs best value, features, build.Dont buy if -If oval shaped buds dont fit you.More of a metal head.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Excellent Sound Quality Even After 2 Years of Use
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I have been using these OnePlus Buds for over 2 years, and they are still working perfectly. The Bluetooth connectivity is fast and stable, with no connection issues.The noise cancellation works really well, especially in public places, making it much easier to enjoy music or take calls. The bass is deep and powerful, and the overall sound quality is excellent. The call quality and battery life are also very good.Even after two years of regular use, the performance is almost the same as when I first bought them. Overall, this is a great product and definitely worth the money. Highly recommended!

I've been using it for about more than 1.5 months now and so far they're performing really well. I've used OnePlus Buds before and my previous one lasted for over 2 years. I've been using these for almost 6-8hrs at least daily and they're getting the job done.The battery life is good and if you've a fast charging adapter (more than 50W) then it'll charge the case fast.The mic quality is good for the price, the voice is clear and crisp.The Transperant mode is quite good and the noise cancellation is decent but sometimes in really loud places it may not feel enough but trust me it's good enough for the price you're paying.The bluetooth connectivity is fast just like the previous gen of OnePlus Buds and maybe even better since now they're using Google device/My Device to pair it and not just relaying on Bluetooth only like before.The sound quality is good. Like it's going to feel like you're using something premium when you're using it under the right circumstances and they even let you have all the customisation and Equalizer in the buds settings so you don't even have to download anything else (may not be the case for all devices but for me i don't have to download anything else since it's all there)As for durability, I'm not the one to just throw my buds around or something like that but they do feel sturdy and even if someone really big/fat person stepped on it, it will be fine or if you dropped them from a high level they should be fine. But the case needs to be protected a bit because if you're too rough with it then it'll get scratches but I've been lucky enough to keep it safe and scratch less (thank goodness for that) and they look good. At least better than the Pro varient in my opinion.But the only problem I've with them is the fit might not be perfect. Like they won't fall out of your ear or anything but sometimes it feels like (at least for me) that the right bud is falling out of the eat but it's there so it just freaks you out at times or you maybe just reassuring if it's securely fit there but you can rest assured and if you have second thoughts then just wear them and just up and down and change the tips to fit your size.Overall it's great.
Have been using this for over a year now and haven't had any issues uptill now. Great sound quality in this range. Looks, feels and sounds premium. Go for it.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: OnePlus Buds 3: Impressive Sound, Long Battery Life, and Stylish DesignOnePlus Buds 3: Impressive Sound, Long Battery Life, and Stylish Design
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought the OnePlus Buds 3 in May 2024, and I’ve been really impressed with them. Here’s my breakdown:Functionality: The Smart Adaptive Noise Cancellation is a standout feature. It adjusts based on your surroundings, so whether I’m in a busy café or at home, it keeps the audio clear and immersive. The sliding volume control is intuitive and super convenient—I don’t need to pull out my phone to adjust the sound, making it perfect when I’m on the move.Durability: The buds feel solid and well-built, with a comfortable fit that stays secure in my ears. I’ve used them during workouts and runs, and they’ve held up well, no issues with them falling out or feeling uncomfortable. The case is compact and sturdy, so I don’t worry about it getting scratched or damaged.Latency: There’s virtually no noticeable lag when gaming or watching videos, which is a huge plus for a pair of TWS earbuds. Audio and video sync up perfectly, so I can enjoy media without any annoying delays.Color: The Splendid Blue color is gorgeous! It’s sleek and unique without being too flashy, and I’ve gotten plenty of compliments on them. The finish on the case and the buds themselves feels premium and adds to the overall aesthetic.Battery Life: The fast charging is amazing—just 10 minutes gives me 7 hours of playtime, which is super convenient when I’m in a rush. With up to 44 hours of playback in total (with the case), I rarely find myself needing to charge them, even with daily use.Music Quality: The Hi-Res sound quality is crystal clear, with great bass and balanced mids and highs. Whether I’m listening to music, podcasts, or watching videos, the sound is immersive and detailed, making everything from gaming to listening to my favorite tunes a joy.Overall, the OnePlus Buds 3 offer a great balance of functionality, sound quality, and design. The battery life and noise cancellation alone make them worth it, and the fast charging is a huge bonus. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a reliable, stylish pair of earbuds!

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great Value for the Price, but Noise Cancellation Could Be Better.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I purchased the OnePlus 3 In-Ear TWS Bluetooth Earbuds in July 2024, and after 6-7 months of daily use (2-3 hours per day), here’s my honest review. My primary usage includes office meetings and YouTube streaming.✅ Pros:✔ Sleek & Lightweight Design – Comfortable for extended wear.✔ Durable Build – Have dropped them multiple times, and they still work fine.✔ Fast & Reliable Connectivity – Pairs quickly with two devices.✔ Quick Charging –Charging case can be plugged in while using the buds.Buds start charging automatically when placed in the case.10-minute charge = ~80% battery, which lasts about an hour.✔ Long Battery Life – On a full charge, lasts 3+ hours of continuous use.✔ Customizable Controls – Touch gestures for volume, play, pause, and skipping tracks, configurable via the app.✔ Good Sound Quality – Clear and balanced audio for the price range.❌ Cons:🔹 Picks Up Surrounding Noise – The mic amplifies background sounds, making it difficult for others to hear me on calls, especially in a shared workspace.🔹 Noise Cancellation is One-Way – Helps reduce noise when listening but does not cut out background noise while speaking. Not sure if any settings can fix this.🔋 Long-Term Battery Performance – TBDSo far, battery life is solid, but I’ll update if I notice any degradation over time.💡 Final Verdict:✅ Great value for money with impressive battery life and sound quality.❌ Not ideal for noisy environments due to the mic picking up background sounds.If you can overlook the mic issue, this is a solid buy at its price point!

Have been using this since Feb 2024, 2.5 years almost. The response from the start has been great. Battery life is brilliant. Case’s battery lasts atleast 2-3 weeks for me. Call quality is decent. Music is crisp and bass is also nice at this price range. Comfortable for travel.
